messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER: GPU pool 'inference-prod' has hit autoscaler ceiling. current_nodes=48 max_nodes=48 pending_pods=122 queue_latency > 3s for 12m. autoscaler_reason=scale_limit_reached. Link: https://console.internal/redwood/metrics?pool=inference-prod

amber_oncall: I'm on it. Observing sustained request queue growth in us-west1 and elevated token latencies. Is this impacting hosted customers?

carla-ops: Confirmed. Several high-throughput routes are seeing request throttles. New jobs are PENDING because HPA can't add nodes; nodepool quota shows used=48/48. Pod Pending reasons: Insufficient cpu (but really GPU resource scheduling + taints).

ben_platform: FYI there is a safety gate on increasing max_nodes that requires infra-approver; it was set after last surge. We can do a temporary override but need a quick thumbs from Platform leads.

maria-cs: Which customers are affected? I have two enterprise customers in active sessions. If we need to hotfix, I'll prep comms.

alejandra-support: Seeing elevated error rates from the worker queue; support tickets are starting to pile. ETA on mitigation?

amber_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) push some traffic to fallback-models/us-east1, 2) open manual cap raise to +8 nodes in us-west1 (temporary), 3) start eviction of low-priority batch jobs. Need platform approval for (2). Will also run quick rolling drain check to avoid long reschedules.

dan_eng: Can we do lighter-weight fixes first? We can enable aggressive batching window reduction and increase max-concurrency per pod temporarily, which might buy a few minutes. Doing that now on 3 hottest routes.

carla-ops: Doing step 1 & 3: added route-level fallback (model: rdm-small) and applied QoS drop for batch-queue (priorityClassName: low-priority). Patch for queue eviction: 

```
kubectl -n inference apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: batch-evict-lowprio
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload: batch
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 60
EOF
```

carla-ops: Applied. Starting to cordon a subset of nodes to free up schedulable slots for high-priority pods.

ben_platform: I'm in a call with infra-approver now. Quick note: quota bump requires approval and then a cloud provider request; we can do a k8s autoscaler override for safety window but need to annotate audit. If you want the quick override, confirm +reason.

amber_oncall: Approve manual override for +8 nodes for 60 minutes to clear backlog. Reason: production serving SLO breach; active enterprise sessions. I'll take responsibility.

ben_platform: Roger. Initiating temporary override. Executing command to patch autoscaler maxNodes.

infra-bot: COMMAND_EXEC: Updating cluster-autoscaler config for pool inference-prod: maxNodes: 56 -> requested by ben_platform (approval: amber_oncall). AuditID=cb7a2f.

carla-ops: Noting pod density limits: per-node pod max 110, but GPU device plugin imposes packing constraints; even with nodes added we might need to increase per-node pod limit or schedule more pods per GPU. Monitoring node allocatable.

ben_platform: Manual override done. cloud-req-id=REQ-2026-83, expected node provisioning ~3-5m. Keep draining optional; don't evict user-attached sessions.

maria-cs: I notified the two affected enterprise customers about degraded performance and that we're actively scaling. They asked for ETA; I gave 10-15m.

alejandra-support: Ticket backlog reduced from 18 -> 7 after the route fallback. Will follow up once nodes are back.

dan_eng: Nodes are coming up, but we see pending init containers on the new nodes failing because of image pull rate limits. Kicking pre-warmed images to the node pool now.

carla-ops: Workaround: set imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent on hot paths and pre-pull images via daemonset onto new nodes. Implemented.

infra-bot: NODE_PROVISIONING: 6 new nodes added to pool inference-prod (node names: ip-10-0-3-12, ip-10-0-3-13, ip-10-0-3-14...). All passed readiness checks.

amber_oncall: Great. Observed queue reduction to baseline and token latencies dropping. Marking incident as mitigated for immediate customer impact. Leaving autoscaler override active for 30 more minutes to ensure stability.

ben_platform: Reminder: we must revert the manual override and attach a postmortem explaining why the autoscaler ceiling was hit (suggest add: better pre-warming, revised scale policies, and bump default max_nodes for this pool). I'll set a follow-up with infra owners.

maria-cs: Customers acknowledged comms and asked for root cause timeline. Maria will coordinate a short status update after postmortem.

amber_oncall: Filing incident ticket INC-2026-142. Assigning to carla-ops & ben_platform for RCA. If anyone sees new regressions, ping immediately. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: NOTE: autoscaler override will auto-revert at 2026-03-15T14:05:00Z unless extended. Audit log: https://console.internal/redwood/audit/REq-2026-83
